subject.title: feat: add safe hybrid local archive collection

question: Should Discrawl support hybrid Git-snapshot plus local archive collection as a first-class core workflow, including routine safe merges that preserve local rows and honor persistent channel exclusions?
rationale: The remaining question is whether these archive and upgrade semantics belong in the supported product contract; tests and successful checks cannot choose that direction.

options.title: Sponsor the hybrid archive contract
options.body: Approve the preservation and exclusion guarantees as supported behavior, then merge after normal maintainer review.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only the separately desired safeguards or exclusion behavior and defer the broader hybrid archive workflow until its contract is designed.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Decline the core feature for now and revisit it only with an agreed archive-product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the hybrid archive contract
recommendation.body: Approve the preservation and exclusion guarantees as supported behavior, then merge after normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the complete proposed workflow and can clarify intended operational guarantees for the maintainer decision.
